<reason>A made the debate easier to decide: secret WTP quotes extract, hide the tag, and disable the comparison B needed. B did real damage on workability and coupon/loyalty overlap, but never squarely defended charging more because a shopper will not leave, and refusing disclosure undercut the “faster coupon” frame. A’s open-offer vs hidden-profile line was imperfect, yet remained a voteable reading of the motion.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>B’s strongest hit was that A’s “hold scarcity, vary the profile” audit would also outlaw loyalty/coupon engines; A’s pressure on the midnight surcharge, plus the following-price attack on exit/competition, kept the extraction/fairness route live.</best_rebuttal>
